title: Which labels, and the fire that burned his contracts
summary: Longhair cannot recall which labels he recorded on because his house burned with his contracts; he cut roughly a hundred tunes.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Did you, uh, was this all on, uh, Aladdin and Imperial, or? Yeah. So many different labels.

I just remember what, exactly what label I did any of them on because my house got burnt down and burned up all my contracts, paper work, and everything. I got loose track. You can go back and memorize a lot of things by looking at, you know, sketches and things. Yeah. Yeah.
But I did pretty close to about a hundred and some tunes, you know. Mm-hmm.
